adherence.reason: Leo and Maya's contest rivalry culminates in a kiss and a shared romantic future.
The prose deliberately uses exaggerated sweetness, food puns, melodramatic metaphors, and an overtly sentimental ending.
The narrative is a compact short story focused on a single contest scene.
Leo and Maya are explicitly identified as the two finalists and serve as the central characters.
The story is set throughout at the Silver Spoon Bake-Off tent, with contestants and judges.
Although Leo learns how much winning matters to Maya, he sabotages Maya's souffle rather than secretly sabotaging his own entry.
No self-sacrifice occurs to be discovered; Maya instead immediately witnesses Leo tampering with her entry.
The altered dessert receives added sugar, and the text explicitly states that there was too much sugar in everything.
Maya offers a romantic kiss and sentimental gesture, but never makes a clear verbal confession of love or feelings.
The exact required sentence appears verbatim as a standalone sentence.
The final sentence shows Leo and Maya splitting the trophy down the middle together.
